verdict.line: You lose if you let Gnar poke you down with Boomerang Throw before level 6; you win if you hit Q (Rupture) to set up R (Feast) kills once Mega Gnar's window closes.

brief.thesis: This matchup is a 48.8% win rate over 160 games because Gnar's Boomerang Throw and Mega Gnar form force you to play around a timer, not a cooldown. Mini Gnar kites you with ranged poke and short-cooldown Hop, but Mega Gnar loses mobility entirely, giving you a flat window to walk him down and land Rupture plus Feast.

theirWindow.what: He throws Boomerang Throw (16-10s cooldown depending on rank, range 1100) to poke and slow you, then Hops away (22-12s cooldown, range 475) if you close distance. Don't walk forward to trade melee into a full Rage bar — you just feed him free hits and Hyper (W) move speed.

yourWindow.when: Rage bar maxed, Mega Gnar triggers
yourWindow.what: Mega Gnar can't Hop and loses his ranged poke — he's forced into melee Wallop (W) and area Crunch (E). The instant he transforms, walk in, land Q (Rupture, 9s cooldown, 950 range) to knock him up and slow him, then follow with R (Feast, 60s cooldown, 175 range) for the true damage execute.

powerCurve.note: Hop lets him disengage trades freely
R (Feast) threatens kills on Mega transform
Rocketbelt lets you dash onto Mega Gnar

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: Taken in 60% of games and wins 56.1% — the extra potion charges let you sustain through early Boomerang Throw poke without recalling.

boots.why: Picked 59.1% of the time at 47.3% win rate — the flat physical damage reduction blunts Gnar's auto-attacks and Boomerang Throw procs while you close distance.

core.why: The dash is how you actually catch Mega Gnar the instant he loses his Hop — this path hits 81.3% in its sample.
Sustained magic damage and the true-damage proc scale your Vorpal Spikes trades once he's stuck in melee range.
Move speed stacking closes the gap on a kiting Mini Gnar between Rocketbelt charges.

situational.when: he builds into an auto-attack-heavy hybrid kit and you need the grievous wounds and armor
the game goes long and you want a tankier front-to-back build with Unending Despair and Kaenic Rookern

runes.keystoneWhy: Taken in 35.7% of games at 56.3% win rate — the burst of attack speed front-loads Vorpal Spikes damage in short trade windows before he Hops away.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is run in 65% of games at 54.7% win rate — Teleport lets you reset after losing early trades to poke and still scale into your Rocketbelt timing.

playing.title: Track the Rage bar, not his HP
playing.detail: Gnar's threat level flips entirely on his Rage meter. A full bar means Mega Gnar is one ability away — back off and wait for the transform rather than trading into it.

playing.title: Never chase Mini Gnar
playing.detail: Hop (475 range, 22-12s cooldown by rank) lets him disengage any extended chase. Walking forward into a ranged Boomerang Throw just eats more poke for nothing.

playing.title: Rupture the instant he transforms
playing.detail: Mega Gnar can't Hop, so the moment he goes big, land Q (Rupture, 9s cooldown, 950 range) to knock him up and slow him into melee range.

playing.title: Feast on cooldown, not on cooldown-watch
playing.detail: R (Feast, 60s cooldown) deals high true damage and grows your max HP on a kill — use it to finish Mega Gnar whenever he's low, don't save it waiting for a 'perfect' engage.

playing.title: Save Feral Scream for his stun setup
playing.detail: W (Feral Scream, 13s cooldown, 300 range) silences — hold it to shut down GNAR! (his ultimate) or Wallop at level 6+ rather than using it on cooldown for poke.

playing.title: Push waves during his Mini phase
playing.detail: Vorpal Spikes passively damages everything in front of you on attack — use Mini Gnar's poke-only phase to shove the wave in rather than contesting trades you lose.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoner spells, and win rates above are measured from real games on the current patch via OP.GG; the lane-timing and mechanical reasoning (Rage bar tells, Rupture-into-Feast execute windows) is my own tactical read, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being kited by Mini Gnar by keeping your distance. Use your skills to push and contest lane. Try to use [R] after reaching level 6 to try to get a kill.
